title: GroupManifest
description: A group of people with a vault of its own — a community, an association, a club, a team. The group's identity and its members: who belongs (`members`), who manages it (`admins`), who created it (`owner`: the eName of the person who created the group). Lives in the group's own vault. Optional fields carry what a community platform shows and manages about it: its address, branding, kinds of membership and of absence, and per-member facts. A group that is also a legal entity has its legal identity and board on an Organization record, which points here (groupManifestEnvelopeId) and to which `organizationEName` points back.

name.description: Human readable name assigned to the group

description.description: Human readable brief description for the group

slug.description: The group's short URL name, chosen by the group (e.g. 'de-woonwolk'). Any platform may write it; none should derive one from the name. Not unique across W3DS: the group's eName is what identifies it.

address.description: Where people find the group: its visiting address. A legal entity's registered seat is a different fact and lives on its Organization record. Absent when the group has none.

postalCode.description: Postal code as written in that country

houseNumberAddition.description: Addition to the house number, kept apart from it ('C' in 163C)

geo.description: Where the address is on the map, and how that was decided

source.description: 'manual': a person placed the pin; 'geocoded': derived from the address text, so only an estimate

precision.description: How close the pin is claimed to be

updatedAt.description: When the pin was last decided

branding.description: How the group presents itself beyond its avatar (which is its logo)

photoUrl.description: A photo of the group or its place, as a URL or w3ds://file URI

primaryColor.description: The group's colour, as a hex colour

titleFont.description: The font family the group's name is set in

members.description: Array of eNames of all members, with an indication of managers and a chair

memberDetails.description: Facts about members beyond their eName, one entry per member who has any; `members` stays the list of who belongs. An entry for an eName not in `members` is ignored.

participantId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the member's User profile, the id Chat.participantIds uses

joinedAt.description: When the member joined the group (YYYY-MM-DD)

membershipTypeId.description: The member's kind of membership: an id from `membershipTypes`

membershipTypes.description: The kinds of membership the group has (e.g. 'Member', 'Supporting member'), and whether each carries a vote in its decisions

id.description: Identifier, unique within the group; memberDetails[].membershipTypeId refers to it

name.description: The kind as shown to people

description.description: What this kind of membership means

votingRights.description: Whether members of this kind vote in the group's decisions. Always written; a reader that finds none keeps what it knew.

availabilityTypes.description: The group's own words for being unavailable (e.g. 'Holiday', 'Sick'), each mapped to the AvailabilityStatus state a member's status of that kind is published as. A member's status itself is their own AvailabilityStatus, in their own vault; this only names the kinds.

name.description: The kind as shown to people; a status carries it as typeName

state.description: The AvailabilityStatus state this kind is published as

charter.description: Attached charter document, either in full or in reference (TBD)—if any

admins.description: Charter allows to add admins. If more than one, need a special one, the Chair. Chair will be considered by Social Nets as an Admin, as they may not see many admins.

owner.description: The eName of the group owner

chatId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the group's own Chat, in the same vault. Absent while it has none.

organizationEName.description: When the group is (also) a legal entity whose Organization record lives in a separate company vault: that vault's eName. Readers take the group's board and legal details from there. The Organization record points back with groupManifestEnvelopeId.

updatedAt.description: When the group manifest was last updated
